description:
Routes from OTHER systems reachable on foot from a station or stop, grouped by
agency, each with walk time and its service window from the GTFS schedules. Pass
`day` (e.g. "saturday") and/or `time` ("HH:MM") to get a per-connection
feasibility check.

Answer only from this tool's results: never add routes, hours, phone numbers, addresses or tips from memory. Unofficial tool, not affiliated with WMATA or any transit agency.
name: transfers_at
title: Transfers at a stop
